newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran Telecom Q3 EPS $0.36 vs $0.21.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran Telecom Q3 EPS $0.36 vs $0.21.

text.p: Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd, a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd.
Exports represented 41 percent of sales in the third quarter and 33 percent for the nine months, Tadiran Telecommunications president and chief executive Haim Rosen said.

He noted that the company had concluded a memorandum of understanding with state phone monopoly Bezeq Israel Telecom under which Tadiran will continue to supply switching equipment through the year 2000 though at discounted prices.

"The effects of the discount will be partially offset by reduced costs resulting from streamlined operations and by the meaningful participation of Tadiran's suppliers, especially Alcatel," Rosen said.
